mission: Ensure every canonical bot inherits verified shared improvements by default so fleet-wide gains happen through common infrastructure instead of repeated per-bot patches.
applies_to: every canonical bot, division, and declared capability
inheritance_rules: shared canonical improvements are preferred over bot-specific patches when behavior is reusable
every bot consumes the newest verified compatible shared version by default
bot-specific behavior is implemented as configuration, policy, plugin, adapter, or domain extension before forking shared code
a bot may override shared behavior only with a documented domain reason, owner, tests, benchmark evidence, and compatibility boundary
overrides must not weaken global guardrails, permissions, privacy, truthfulness, or security requirements
when a shared improvement closes gaps for multiple bots, affected bots are automatically marked for retest
when a bot-specific improvement is reusable, builders must evaluate promotion into shared infrastructure
shared improvements must preserve backward-compatible contracts where practical and document migrations when not
no bot may copy and locally modify a shared implementation merely to customize behavior; use extension points instead
duplicate shared logic discovered across bots becomes a consolidation candidate and benchmark gap
a regression in shared infrastructure reopens affected bot benchmarks rather than hiding failures behind local workarounds
promotion_pipeline: builder checks whether the improvement is domain-specific or reusable
reusable improvement receives a canonical shared owner
shared implementation is created or existing shared owner is upgraded
affected bots inherit the shared version
affected bot suites retest in parallel
regressions are reconciled through configuration/extension points where possible
shared improvement is marked adopted only after fleet evidence passes

fleet_retest.rule: Only impacted bots need full retest unless the shared change touches global runtime, security, permissions, routing, memory, or data contracts; global changes trigger broader fleet verification.

shared_winners.audio_analyzer_improvement: promote to shared multimodal/audio analysis owner
shared_winners.builder_strategy: promote to builder platform and benchmark-gap workflow
shared_winners.security_or_privacy_fix: promote immediately to shared policy/runtime when broadly applicable

truth_rule: Declaring inheritance does not prove every bot has already migrated. Builders must generate and verify an adoption map from the canonical registry/runtime before claiming fleet-wide adoption.
